tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga mdor bsdus bzhugs so//

/rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig thun mtshams su gtor ma brgya rtsa'i go rim bgyi bar 'dod na// dkar gsum mngar gsum sman dang me tog sna tshogs kyis sbags pa'i 'bras zan sogs kyi ril bu bcu tshan bcu dang brgyad tshan gcig bya/ zangs sam rin po che las byas pa'i gtor snod khri'u khar mdun du bzhag pa'i nang du lha bshos sam ril bu che ba gcig blugs la/ skyabs sems spyi 'gro ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*// rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs| |kha sarpa ṇi gsal ba yi// thugs ka'i 'od gyis mgron rnams bkug /oṃ badzra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes mgron rigs bzhi spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la chu gshegs/ bcu tshan dang po bshams la chus bkang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ bdun dang / arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma 'dod yon mchog 'di rtsa brgyud kyi// bla ma rtsa gsum rgyal sras zhi khro'i tshogs// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro chos srung dam can tshogs| |mchog gsum skyabs gyur rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyangs rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog / bcu tshan gnyis pa gong ltar las| rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro chos srung dam can tshogs// dpal mgon bdun cu dkar phyogs skyong rnams kyis// gtor ma 'di bzhes bstan pa dar ba dang*// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen spel bar mdzod/ /bcu tshan gsum pa gong ltar las/ rig 'dzin dge sbyong bram ze la sogs pa// mngon par shes ldan tshogs rnams gtor ma 'dis/ /mnyes nas bdag sogs 'gro rnams byang chub pa'i// smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyor bgyi bar gsol| | bcu tshan bzhi pa gong ltar las/

rnam mang thos sras rmugs 'dzin nor skyong tshogs// lhan skyes lhar bcas gtor mas re skong la// bdag gi nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig / bcu tshan lnga pa gong ltar las/ mchod pa'i mal du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod la/ 'dzam bu gling gi gzhi bdag brtan ma'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu sde brgyad rnams/ /gtor ma 'di bzhes 'dod dgu dpag yas kyi/ /lhag par bdag sogs 'gro rnams srung du gsol| | bcu tshan drug pa gong ltar las/ gnod sbyin sde dpon pho mo yul 'khor skyong*/ /'phrog ma 'brog gnas tshogs rnams gtor ma bzhes/ /'gro bar gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa rab zhi nas// chos ldan rnam dkar dge ba'i las mdzod cig / bcu tshan bdun pa gong ltar las/ bgegs dang log 'dren nad rigs gdon gyi bdag /bdag cag rnams la gnod pa'i 'byung po kun| |gtor ma 'di bzhes gnod 'tshe'i sems spong la// byang chub sems bskyed dam pa'i lam 'jug shog / bcu tshan brgyad pa gong ltar las/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam lnga skye gnas bzhi// bsdus pa'i tshogs bcas 'gro ba mar gyur sems// gtor mas tshims nas sdug bsngal kun bral te// phar phyin drug rdzogs byang chub thob gyur cig / bcu tshan dgu pa gong ltar las/ yi dwags phyi nang zas skom sgrib pa can// bying dang kha 'thor gnas kun gtor ma 'dis// tshims nas ser sna'i las sgrib yongs dag nas// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa thob gyur cig /bcu tshan bcu pa gong ltar las/ bdag cag 'khor ba thog ma med nas bzung*// da lta'i bar gyi lan chags gdon bgegs tshogs// gtor mas re skong lan chags 'khon dag cing*| |rdo rje theg pa'i lam du 'jug gyur cig /brgyad tshan yang gong ltar las/ gtor mar re zhing glo bur 'dir lhags pa'i// khas zhan dbang chung lhag ma bshal chu la// re ba rnams kyang gtor ma 'di khyer la// tshims shing dag pa'i zhing du bgrod par shog

/ces brjod gtor ma gshegs la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las sogs kyis chos sbyin bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ sbyin pa chen po 'di yi mthus// sogs kyis bden stobs brjod/ mgron rnams so so'i re 'dod yongs gang nas// rang rang gnas su gshegs la gang gi tshe// spyan drangs dus su slar yang 'byon pa dang*| |bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra mu/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ bkra shis dang bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// zhes pa'i gtor chog 'di yang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa bya khyung ba rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin gyi gsang yum a che skyid kyi thugs dam bgyi ba'i slad du/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas gzhu spro lung du sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
